source: You touch a willing beast and, for the duration, perceive through its senses as well as your own. You can use your action to see and hear through the beast instead of yourself, gaining any special senses it has; while you do, you are blind and deaf to your own surroundings.
Pick one skill. You are proficient in it for the duration, the training surfacing as though remembered from a life that was not yours.
Spinning daggers fill a 5-foot cube centred on a point within range. Entering the cube for the first time in a turn, or beginning a turn inside it, costs a creature 4d4 slashing damage.

You plant four pieces of nonmagical ammunition in the ground and ward the area around them. Until the spell ends, whenever a creature other than you comes within 30 feet of the ammunition for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, one piece flies up to strike it: the creature makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 1d6 piercing damage, and that piece of ammunition is spent.

One humanoid you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed. While charmed it must use its action before moving each turn to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself that you choose. It can make a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.

A whirlwind of swirling dust fills a 5-foot cube within range. A creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of it must make a Strength saving throw, taking 1d8 bludgeoning damage and being pushed 10 feet on a failure. As a bonus action you can move the dust devil 30 feet.

Bands of yellow force loop around a creature you can see within range. Failing a Strength saving throw drops its flying speed to 0, and it sinks 60 feet each round until it reaches the ground or the spell ends.

You bless a willing creature with luck. Once before the spell ends it can roll an additional d20 on an attack roll, ability check or saving throw and use either result, or force an attacker to reroll against it.

You rewrite the last 6 seconds of a conversation. Every creature that heard you remembers you saying something else of your choosing, provided it is not obviously false, and you gain advantage on a Charisma check made in the same exchange.

A nature spirit appears in a 5-foot cube within range. When a creature enters that space on its turn or starts its turn there, you can use your reaction to have the spirit restore 1d6 hit points to it. The spirit can heal a number of times equal to 1 + your spellcasting ability modifier before it vanishes, and you can move it 30 feet as a bonus action.

You touch an object weighing no more than 10 pounds and fix it in place. Nothing can move it unless a creature succeeds on a Strength check against your spell save DC, and casting the spell with a higher slot makes it hold far more weight and last far longer.
You gain supernatural grace. Your walking speed increases by 10 feet, you can move through other creatures' spaces, and your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

A Medium hand of earth rises from the ground and reaches for a creature within range. On a failed Strength saving throw the target takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage and is restrained. As a bonus action you can move the hand to crush a restrained target for 2d6 more.

Draconic mischief fills a 20-foot cube within range. Roll on a table of effects each round: rainbow bubbles that impose disadvantage, a smell that provokes Constitution saves against poisoning, giggling fits that force Wisdom saves against incapacitation, or grasping tentacles of light that force Dexterity saves against being knocked prone.

You consume a nonmagical flame within range and choose an effect. Fireworks burst in a 10-foot radius, blinding creatures that fail a Constitution saving throw until the end of your next turn; or thick smoke fills a 20-foot radius, heavily obscuring it for a minute.

You weave shadow into a blade in your hand. It counts as a simple melee weapon with finesse, light and thrown (range 20/60), deals 2d8 psychic damage on a hit, and grants advantage on attacks against a target in dim light or darkness. If you drop it or throw it, it dissipates at the end of the turn and you can re-form it as a bonus action.
Cloud shapes itself into writing of up to ten words across a stretch of sky you can see. Anyone beneath it can read the message, and it holds until the spell ends.

Magical snowballs burst outward through a 5-foot-radius sphere around a point you pick within range. Each creature inside makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 cold damage on a failure and half as much on a success.

You call a bestial spirit to an unoccupied space you can see within range. It takes an Air, Land or Water form of your choosing and acts on your turn, obeying your verbal commands. Its attack bonus and save DC match your own spellcasting numbers, and it disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends.

You psychically lash one creature you can see within range. It must make an Intelligence saving throw, taking 3d6 psychic damage on a failure and half as much on a success. On a failed save it also cannot take a reaction until the end of its next turn, and on that turn it must choose whether to move, take an action, or take a bonus action.
Pick a creature you can see and an unoccupied space you can see within range. The creature is transported there, though one that objects avoids the trip with a successful Constitution saving throw.

A strong wind howls in a 10-foot radius around you and moves with you. It deafens creatures in it, disperses gas and fog, extinguishes unprotected flames, makes the area difficult terrain for others, and gives ranged weapon attacks entering or leaving it disadvantage.

You invoke both death and life at a point within range. Each creature of your choice in a 10-foot radius must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d6 necrotic damage on a failure and half as much on a success. One creature of your choice in the area can then spend a Hit Die and regain that many hit points plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
A turn of the wrist sends an object you are holding into a pocket dimension. A bonus action calls it back to your hand from anywhere on the plane, and when the spell ends it drops at your feet.

Your body burns with fiery energy. Your speed increases by 20 feet, your movement never provokes opportunity attacks, and each creature you move within 5 feet of takes 1d6 fire damage, once per turn each.
A 30-foot radius of healing energy surrounds you and travels with you until the spell ends. Each turn, a bonus action lets you restore 2d6 hit points to any one creature inside it, yourself included.

The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack while this spell is active, the attack deals an extra 3d8 radiant damage and the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the spell ends. A blinded creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns.

You touch the minds of up to three willing creatures within range and they fall unconscious for the duration. When the spell ends or they take damage they wake, having gained the benefit of a short rest. A creature cannot benefit again until it finishes a long rest.
